whenToUse: Reorderable trees such as store categories or departments, up to three levels.
Renaming, changing slugs and visibility, or moving branches with undo.
avoidWhen: Choosing one node in a form — use tree-select.
a11y: Moves work with Alt + arrow keys and a move menu, not only drag; results are announced via role="status".
Find-in-tree expands matches; keep the selected node marked with aria-current.
